title: Micro-ESP
description: A simple firmware micro-kernel for ESP32 NodeMCU board with an interactive shell and file system support. This micro-kernel is built using ESP-IDF tool, specially designed for NodeMCU ESP32 board.

title: Web Stat
description: A real-time dashboard for tracking the availability and performance of multiple websites. Monitor uptime status, response times, and historical reliability with automatic checks every 5 minutes. Features persistent storage, visual status history, and instant manual checks for all your critical web properties.
